projects.title: Baysor
projects.desc: Lead author and maintainer. Bayesian cell segmentation for imaging-based spatial transcriptomics. Led the 2026 C++ release, improving speed and memory use and making the tool available on Linux, macOS and Windows.

projects.title: conos
projects.desc: Co-first author. Joint graph-based analysis of heterogeneous scRNA-seq collections, including label transfer, batch correction, visualisation and Seurat integration.

projects.title: dropEst
projects.desc: Lead author. Accurate molecule counting for droplet-based scRNA-seq, correcting errors in cell barcodes and UMIs. Extended for RNA-velocity analysis.

projects.title: cacoa
projects.desc: Lead author; PhD thesis. Case-control analysis of cell composition and gene-expression differences, with cell-type-based and cluster-free methods.

projects.title: pagoda2
projects.desc: Co-developer. Processing and analysis of individual scRNA-seq samples; available on CRAN.

projects.title: CellAnnotatoR
projects.desc: Marker-based cell-type annotation of scRNA-seq data.

projects.title: Article Visual Search
projects.desc: Sole developer, intermittent development during 2023–2026. Interactive maps of PubMed and Semantic Scholar literature using embeddings, clustering and optional LLM summaries.

projects.title: GPTCellAnnotator
projects.desc: LLM-assisted cell-type annotation combining GPT-generated candidate labels and marker genes with Scanpy cluster analysis (2023–2024).

projects.title: Hausa speech recognition
projects.desc: ASR benchmarking and Whisper / XLS-R fine-tuning for Family Empowerment Media through SEADS. Published the BibleTTS Hausa dataset on Hugging Face.

projects.title: Modular neural networks
projects.desc: Extended Graph Spectral Regularization to impose arbitrary graph structures on neural networks in an AI Safety Camp collaboration.

projects.title: ggrastr
projects.desc: Original author. Rasterises selected ggplot2 layers while preserving vector graphics elsewhere. On CRAN since 2017; 1.2 million downloads from Posit’s CRAN mirror in the 12 months to November 2026.

projects.title: FastRandPCA.jl
projects.desc: Fast randomised principal component analysis for sparse matrices; a Julia port of frPCA_sparse.

projects.title: litellm-batch
projects.desc: Batch LLM completions through LiteLLM, with progress tracking and aggregate cost reporting.

projects.title: tts-wrappers
projects.desc: A shared asynchronous interface to Google Cloud TTS, Yandex SpeechKit, ElevenLabs and other text-to-speech services.

projects.title: PrettyTasks
projects.desc: A Nextcloud app for hierarchical task management with CalDAV synchronisation.

projects.title: dataorganizer
projects.desc: A research-compendium structure for scientific projects in R.
